title: Macao - ONECOIN - What the hell is this?
description: Maybe the best stuff you can find there in Bulgaria...

asr.full_text: what is an opportunity and a journey? One Academy is your door to the world of digital economy. With every new level you move forward to their goal. A better understanding of finance, money in the monetary system, financial management, financial markets, trading, cryptocurrency and much more. What do you get from ONE Academy? First, you gain knowledge. ONE Academy is a fantastic opportunity to get access to learning resources organized in levels with asc outstanding order of difficulty. While lower levels teach you about the basics of finance, financial management, and the monetary system, upper levels bring you closer to the world of digital economy and the way digital currencies are changing the way we make payments and transactions. Second, you get the opportunity to put your knowledge into practice. Get your educational package along with tokens and combine your knowledge with practical experience. As you progress up the knowledge ladder to level six, you will understand the theoretical foundation of finance and trading and also get the tools to practice your knowledge with ONE coin. Log on with your username and password and enter a whole new world of opportunities. Unfortunately, I could not come today in person to this amazing event, but I would like to state that I am very excited to teach at the One Academy this wonderful project by one part. I would like to say some words about me. I started my business education at the High School of Economics in Sofia, where I finished as an excellent student, and after that I continued my education as a bachelor in finance in the university of national and world economy in Sofia where again I finished as a merit student. After that I started my master's degree in the Burgas Free University where I again finished as a merit student. And before I know it, I started my PhD at the Department of Management at the University of National World Economy. Since then, I have published over 70 works in prestigious journals and conferences around the world. I have finished my PhD on investment modeling, and I'm already 10 years teaching at the University of National and World Economy where I'm an assistant professor. So far I have been personally teaching to more than 10 000 students and I have been consulting several companies here in Bulgaria and abroad. I'm also a certified consultant on small and medium enterprises by the Dutch Gov. And with this, I would like to wish you success with your studies in one academy.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a OneCoin educational package bundled with tokens and presents access to ONE Academy as a path into practicing with the purported cryptocurrency. A separately cited U.S. Justice Department account identifies OneCoin's educational-and-token packages as products sold within a fraudulent cryptocurrency scheme. The video does not state the package price; that program-level sales context is external, not a price spoken in this video.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 is the supported program mechanism: the video promotes a package that bundles educational access with OneCoin tokens, and the separately cited Justice Department source documents the sale of these OneCoin token packages as part of the fraudulent cryptocurrency offer. a paid earning-guidance cue is not assigned because the video does not establish a separately priced earning-guidance service. The package price and any completed purchase are not shown in the video.
